title: In this town, everybody parties except me
format: narrative what-if (Larptuber 'In this town' one-rule world; fiction lane test #3 — the huss-huss chant test)

staged.timestamp_note: all timestamp_start/audio_dur_s are ESTIMATES at 205 WPM + 0.25s gaps for lint pre-clear; the VO stage overwrites them with measured values (L-003). The ~2.6s crowd-chant slam-to-black tail is render-level, outside timeline.total_s (the #0010 loop-to-black pattern).

hook.narration: In this town, everybody parties except me.

visual.v1: night-town wide (reuse #0010 night-town world DNA); every window throws warm party light, distant square glows gold w/ confetti drift; OUR door dead-center, dark, mail slot visible; frame-0 single title stamps 'EVERYBODY PARTIES.' / 'EXCEPT ME.' (L-128: title owns frame 0); far background: a gold envelope silhouette carried on shoulders

scenes.narration: Every dusk, a gold envelope slides under one door.

visual.v1: dusk street row; slow push-in on one door's mail slot; a gold envelope slides in (paper-slide SFX); its name-field glows; that door's window lights warm instantly

scenes.narration: They threw one for a stop sign. The town fountain got two.

visual.v1: two deadpan vignettes: a stop sign wearing a party hat + streamers, tiny crowd dancing around it; then the town fountain with TWO party banners, confetti on the water; day-lit absurdity, zero dialogue energy

scenes.narration: Your envelope comes, they carry you to the square, chanting.

visual.v1: the square at night: crowd silhouettes carry a glowing guest of honor toward a lit stage; red 'HUSS!' stamps pop word-by-word over the crowd (stamp cascade = #0011 seal rig re-colored RED); the chant is CROWD BED only — the narrator never chants (canon law)

scenes.narration: Nine years. My slot never clicks. The neighbor checks it for me.

visual.v1: our dark door by day; mail slot close-up, dust motes, no envelope; the NEIGHBOR (hooded, kind) crouches checking our slot, then pats the door twice (OUR recurring cast plant #1)

scenes.narration: I practice anyway. Wave. Bow. Smile. Four seconds. Too slow. Two.

visual.v1: interior: silhouette practicing toward a mirror; small gray text stamps WAVE / BOW / SMILE pop on metronome ticks; counter stamp '4s' cut with a red TOO-SLOW slash, then '2s'; the rhythm tightens visibly

scenes.narration: The paperboy got his at nine. The chant made the streetlights pulse.

visual.v1: montage: the PAPERBOY's door receives its gold envelope (he salutes it — OUR recurring cast plant #2); then the square at night, party lights pulsing in rhythm with red HUSS stamps — the chant makes the streetlights breathe

scenes.narration: Then, one night. No music. No lights. Nothing.

visual.v1: HARD SILENCE begins (HOLD rig): the same street, all windows dark, square empty; slow empty-street dolly; no stamps, no motion energy — the canon silence beat

VISUAL-ONLY HOLD EXTENSION (~1.9s): the dolly continues down the dead street; at the hold's end the first gold envelope-row resolves out of the fog (a doorstep envelope, upright, unopened, faint glow)

scenes.note: L-097 legal pacing cut: held beat, narration empty on purpose (s6b = canon silence hold; s10b = formation hold before the twist)

scenes.narration: Every window dark. An envelope on every doorstep. Unopened.

visual.v1: walking shot down the dead street: gold envelopes leaning upright on every doorstep, faint gold glow, rows receding into fog; no people anywhere

scenes.narration: Nine years of nothing. Tonight they forget me. I almost smiled.

visual.v1: interior, our mirror from s4: my face lit only by window moonlight; the almost-smile forms and dies; the empty slot visible in frame; a single breath

scenes.narration: Then my slot clicked. My name, in green ink.

visual.v1: THE CLICK: slot close-up; one HEAVY gold envelope slides in slowly, filling the slot (deepest thump of the video, #0011 seal-thump class); the green-ink name-field flares — a calligraphic flourish, deliberately unreadable (mystery bait)

scenes.narration: The whole town outside. Unlit lanterns. The neighbor, crying.

visual.v1: the door cracks open: the ENTIRE town stands in formation rows, hundreds of unlit grey lanterns; the neighbor front row, face lit gold by our envelope, crying; nobody moves
VISUAL-ONLY FORMATION HOLD (~1.3s): the crying neighbor holds; nobody in the crowd moves; the camera begins the slow pull-back that reveals the rehearsal rows — dread beat before the twist

scenes.note: L-097 legal pacing cut: held beat, narration empty on purpose (s6b = canon silence hold; s10b = formation hold before the twist)

scenes.narration: They were never parties. They were rehearsals.

visual.v1: TWIST pull-back wide: the crowd is arranged in choir/performance formation down the square — rehearsal geometry made visible at once; silent red HUSS stamps cascade over them like sheet music

scenes.narration: While they were out partying, by the way, the town practiced. For me.

visual.v1: closer: our hand pushes the door wide; gold light floods the frame; EVERY lantern lights amber in one single frame; the crowd inhales together; SLAM to black on the loudest crowd 'Hush. Hush. Hush.' (SFX only, render-level tail ~2.6s beyond VO end); loop to hook frame
